boards.title: Your First Weekend at Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A campus-based, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented through named Rose-Hulman destinations, recreation, and student-life spaces.

cards.title: Start with the campus map
cards.subtitle: Plan a walking loop across Rose-Hulman’s 200-acre campus
cards.notes: Open the official map before heading out, then use its academic, dining, recreation, and support filters to shape a low-stress first walk.
cards.short_summary: Use the official map to connect the weekend’s stops.
cards.evidence_claim: Rose-Hulman provides an interactive map with filters for academic, dining, recreation, support, and other campus destinations.
cards.access_notes: Use the map to confirm routes and building access before visiting.

cards.title: Get your academic bearings at Moench Hall
cards.subtitle: Main academic building
cards.notes: Walk by Rose-Hulman’s main academic building and note its location for future classes; the official map identifies it as home to several departments.
cards.short_summary: Anchor your first campus walk at the main academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: Moench Hall is Rose-Hulman’s main academic building and houses multiple academic departments.
cards.access_notes: Building access may vary; confirm access before entering.

cards.title: Set up a future study stop at Logan Library
cards.subtitle: Library and Learning Center
cards.notes: Find the main-floor study area and coffee shop, then save the library as a return point when you need books, journals, or a focused workspace.
cards.short_summary: Locate the library’s study area and academic resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Logan Library contains print and electronic collections and has a large main-floor study area and coffee shop.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current library entry and service availability before visiting.

cards.title: Find the student-life hub
cards.subtitle: Dining, lounges, student organizations, and services
cards.notes: Cross the bridge to locate the Union’s lounges, game room, student-organization offices, dining, and Student Affairs so you know where to return.
cards.short_summary: Orient yourself to Rose-Hulman’s central student-services building.
cards.evidence_claim: Mussallem Union includes dining services, meeting rooms, lounges, a game room, Student Affairs, and student-organization offices.
cards.access_notes: Services and rooms may have separate access rules or hours.

cards.title: Plan a Sunday-evening café break
cards.subtitle: Inside John A. Logan Library
cards.notes: If you want a Sunday evening reset, Logan’s lists coffee, smoothies, sandwiches, salads, and desserts; check the posted hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A documented Sunday-evening food and drink option in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Logan’s in Logan Library lists Sunday hours of 6:00 p.m. to midnight and offers drinks, sandwiches, salads, and desserts.
cards.access_notes: Official map data lists Sunday 6:00 p.m.–midnight; verify current hours and payment options before visiting.

cards.title: Locate the Sports and Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Recreation, varsity athletics, and intramurals
cards.notes: Walk over to identify the SRC for a future recreation or intramural visit; the campus map lists the fieldhouse, pool, climbing wall, and fitness center.
cards.short_summary: Know where Rose-Hulman’s major recreation facilities are located.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sports and Recreation Center includes Hulbert Arena, a fieldhouse, swimming pool, rock climbing wall, and fitness center.
cards.access_notes: Facility entry and activity availability may be limited to the campus community; confirm current rules before participating.

cards.title: Identify Cook Stadium and Phil Brown Field
cards.subtitle: Home of Fightin’ Engineers football
cards.notes: Add the stadium to your mental campus map and check the athletics schedule later if you want to attend a properly scheduled home event.
cards.short_summary: Locate Rose-Hulman’s football stadium beside the SRC.
cards.evidence_claim: Cook Stadium at Phil Brown Field is home to the Rose-Hulman Fightin’ Engineers football team.
cards.access_notes: Event entry, schedule, and ticket requirements vary; confirm details through Rose-Hulman Athletics.

cards.title: Spot the campus theater at Hatfield Hall
cards.subtitle: 602-seat theater and Alumni Center
cards.notes: Walk past Hatfield Hall and note the theater location for future performances or campus programs; confirm the event calendar and entry details separately.
cards.short_summary: Find the named campus venue that houses Rose-Hulman’s theater.
cards.evidence_claim: Hatfield Hall houses a 602-seat theater and the Alumni Center.
cards.access_notes: Theater access depends on scheduled events; check current event information before entering.

cards.title: Pause at White Chapel
cards.subtitle: West-side campus chapel overlooking the lake
cards.notes: Include the chapel on a daylight campus loop and appreciate the lake-side setting from public paths; reserve indoor plans for confirmed group access.
cards.short_summary: A named lakeside campus landmark for a quiet daytime stop.
cards.evidence_claim: White Chapel is a campus space for worship and spiritual refuge overlooking the lake on the west side of campus.
cards.access_notes: The chapel is available to outside groups as available; confirm access before entering.

cards.title: Find Oakley Observatory in daylight
cards.subtitle: East-side campus observatory
cards.notes: Locate the observatory during daylight and watch for university-hosted astronomy opportunities; do not assume public telescope access without a confirmed program.
cards.short_summary: Know the location of Rose-Hulman’s named observatory for future programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Oakley Observatory, on the east side of campus, serves faculty, students, and community residents interested in astronomy and houses eight mounted telescopes.
cards.access_notes: Located in woods on the east side of campus; visit only during a confirmed program or with authorized access.
